Metadata.Goal: Expose Domain Operation catalog and execution through a truthful, isolated Elysia server API.
Metadata.Description: Register trusted bundles and current capabilities, project public catalogs, route exact execute requests, normalize pre-routing failures, preserve legacy APIs, and prove boundaries without adding business bundles or UI.

TaskSpace.name: add-domain-operation-server-api
TaskSpace.Description: Use focused RED/implementation slices for registration/catalog and execute routing, then close with compatibility, build, and boundary verification.

TaskGroup.name: Registration and catalog API
TaskGroup.Description: Specify and implement immutable registrations plus leak-free public catalog routes.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: catalog and registration focused tests pass
duplicate ids reject and serialized responses expose no runtime internals

Task.name: Write registration and catalog route RED tests
Task.Description: Add a server-local deterministic bundle fixture and direct app.handle tests for empty/registered catalogs, exact projections, operations/presets, duplicate id rejection, current capabilities, stable 404, load-once behavior, and leak guards. Do not implement routes.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Tests cover all four GET routes for empty, hit, and miss cases using contract DTO expectations
Tests prove duplicate context ids reject, including distinct versions, and bundle identity is catalog-derived
Tests prove explicit serialization excludes seed, bindings, handlers, probes, functions, and mutable/runtime state

Task.name: Implement registration and catalog projection
Task.Description: Add route constants only to web-shared; implement injected registration loading, duplicate-id guard, frozen current capabilities, explicit public projection, and stable GET 404 in web-server. Preserve empty default registration and legacy app lifecycle.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Each unique bundle loads once and id/version have no second configuration truth
GET routes return direct contract-owned projections with registered current capabilities
All registration/catalog RED tests pass and legacy app creation still works with no registrations

TaskGroup.name: Execute routing and isolation
TaskGroup.Description: Specify and implement exact request forwarding, truthful routing failures, and per-request isolation.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: no invalid or unknown context selects a fallback bundle

Task.name: Write execute, error, and isolation RED tests
Task.Description: Add direct app.handle cases for fetched preset request POST parity, original-body forwarding, success/partial/failure HTTP 200 envelopes, missing/invalid context, unknown id/version, no-fallback/no-allocation evidence, and sequential/concurrent deterministic isolation. Do not implement execute routing.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: A fetched complete preset request is posted unchanged and runtime receives the same parsed object/value graph
Invalid and catalog-mismatch cases assert exact diagnostic, nullable facts, no commit/mutations/tree, HTTP 200, and no runtime allocation
Runtime domain statuses and sequential/concurrent fresh-state behavior are covered

Task.name: Implement execute routing and failure envelopes
Task.Description: Use the contract request-fact projector for context resolution, construct truthful transport-side failure responses, pass the original parsed body and frozen current capabilities to runtime, and return every execute envelope with HTTP 200. Do not reconstruct requests or allocate server-owned SQLite.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Resolved requests are forwarded without clone, merge, normalization, or defaults
Missing/invalid context reports REQUEST_VALIDATION_FAILED and unknown/version mismatch reports OPERATION_CATALOG_MISMATCH truthfully
All execute/error/isolation tests pass and server retains no live execution resources

TaskGroup.name: Compatibility, build, and boundaries
TaskGroup.Description: Close the transport slice with legacy regressions, declared builds, import guards, and capsule integrity.

cdt:Gate.cdt:Criterion: web-server, contracts, and runtime focused tests pass
web-server typecheck/build and root build pass without --if-present
boundary guard and protected capsule hashes pass

Task.name: Verify legacy compatibility, build, and package boundaries
Task.Description: Declare direct web-server contract/runtime dependencies and a real typecheck build, make root build mandatory, add/extend source import guards, run health/execute-kon regressions plus focused suites/builds, and verify capsule regular-file and direct-symlink hashes remain unchanged.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Existing health and execute-kon behavior remains covered and passing
Web-server declares public dependencies; package typecheck/build and root build pass without optional skip
Guard rejects capsule, halfcode, dist, node_modules, internal/unallowlisted subpaths, and test-fixture imports from production source
Protected capsule hashes equal both recorded baselines

cdt:AttractorCheck.note: Fresh rerun after two bounded corrections found NO_GAP: TypeScript-AST import guard covers TS/TSX/static/resolved dynamic imports and rejects private/capsule/generated/test/subpath patterns; executable capsule manifests match 564 regular files and 9 direct links; web-server 28/28, contract/runtime 172/172, typecheck, package/root builds, strict Codument validation, HTTP facts, isolation, legacy compatibility and boundaries pass. Report: reports/attractor-check-report.md.
